fields.Idea title: STUDY • PLAY • PROGRESS – Football & Education Programme for Students Aged 14+
fields.The concept:
I want to establish a football and education programme for students aged 14–18 in Bahrain, combining structured football training with academic learning. The aim is to give young people the opportunity to develop as footballers while continuing their education and preparing for university or employment.
The programme will work with schools, educational institutions and football organisations to provide professional coaching, academic pathways, sports science, performance analysis and career guidance. It will help students balance their sporting ambitions with their education rather than having to choose between the two.
fields.How the money will be spent:
Football coaches and programme staff  BD 4,000
Training facilities and equipment   BD 2,500
Educational resources and academic delivery  BD 2,000
Sports science and performance analysis BD 1,500
Marketing and student recruitment  BD 1,000
Administration, safeguarding and operations  BD 1,500
Transport and student activities  BD 1,000
Contingency  BD 1,500
Total BD 15,000
fields.Expected return:
The programme will charge an annual fee of BD 1,250 per student. With an initial target of 30 students, the expected annual revenue will be BD 37,500. As the programme develops, the target is to increase enrolment to 50 students, generating up to BD 62,500 in annual revenue.

Additional income will be generated through school partnerships and sponsorship agreements. The aim is to recover the initial BD 15,000 investment, establish a financially sustainable programme and expand across Bahrain. These figures represent projected gross revenue before operating expenses.
fields.Market demand today:
There is a growing opportunity in Bahrain for programmes that combine professional football development with academic education. Youth football already has a strong presence, with approximately 3,000 players aged 5–17 expected to participate in the Junior Premier League Bahrain's 2026 season. 
The Ministry of Education is also actively supporting the development of school sports through professional training programmes and partnerships with international sports organisations. 
My project aims to address an important opportunity for students aged 14–18 who want to pursue football while continuing their education. By combining qualified coaching, sports science, academic pathways and career guidance, the programme will offer students and parents a more complete development pathway.
The target market includes Bahraini and international school students and families who are willing to invest in their children's sporting and educational futures. The aim is to establish partnerships with schools and attract an initial group of 30 students, with potential to expand across Bahrain.

As a recent Computer Science graduate from United Arab Emirates University, I am actively seeking a full-time entry-level role where I can begin my professional journey, contribute meaningfully, and grow into a well-rounded technology professional.

I would describe myself as a driven, curious, and dedicated individual who takes pride in the quality of my work. Throughout my studies, I maintained a GPA of 3.66/4.00 and was recognized on the Dean's List across multiple semesters, which reflects my consistency, discipline, and genuine passion for the field. I enjoy solving complex problems, learning new technologies quickly, and collaborating with others toward a shared goal. I believe in continuous self-improvement, which is why I recently enrolled in the Full Stack Development Program at Reboot in Manama to further strengthen my foundations in modern software engineering, Go programming, and algorithmic problem-solving.

My professional experience has given me a well-rounded view of the technology industry from both engineering and consulting perspectives. During my internship at The BENEFIT Company in Manama, I worked as a Software Engineer Intern, developing SQL objects and web pages for the Switch Reports Portal and enhancing the functionality of the GCC Dispute Portal using VB.NET, ASP.NET, and SQL Server. This experience exposed me to enterprise-level software development within Bahrain's financial technology sector and reinforced my appreciation for writing dependable, maintainable code in a production environment.

More recently, as a Junior Consultant Intern at Capgemini, I have broadened my perspective beyond pure engineering. I completed professional training through Capgemini University in areas including business ethics, agentic AI, and cybersecurity awareness. In my daily work, I have applied AI tools to clean and preprocess text data, and I have researched and evaluated AI-driven solutions for automating the conversion of Word documents into PowerPoint presentations. This role has strengthened my ability to combine technical execution with a consulting mindset—understanding needs, evaluating tools objectively, and delivering practical outcomes.

Looking ahead, I am seeking an opportunity where I can apply my technical foundation in software engineering, artificial intelligence, and modern web development while continuing to learn from experienced professionals. I am particularly drawn to organizations that value innovation, invest in the growth of their people, and offer the chance to work on meaningful projects that create real impact. My goal is to build a long-term career with an employer where I can grow technically, professionally, and personally over the years to come.

I have attached my CV for your review and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background, skills, and ambitions can align with the needs of your organization. Thank you for taking the time to consider my application.

اتكيف مع بيئة العمل الجماعي او الفردي، مرونة في إدارة الوقت، العمل تحت الضغط، الترتيب والتنظيم

Lama Mohammed Shukeralla Riffa, Bahrain | +973 39155388 | lamashukeralla@gmail.com | LinkedIn

Professional Summary CIPD-qualified Human Resource Management graduate from Bahrain Polytechnic (GPA 3.6). Equipped with strong skills in HR administration, data analytics, active listening, and problem-solving. Seeking to leverage expertise in data analysis and creative problem-solving to pursue a rewarding career in people development.

Education & Certifications

CIPD Associate Membership | July 2026 Bachelor of Business (Human Resources Management) | GPA 3.6 Bahrain Polytechnic, Isa Town, Bahrain | Graduated February 2026 High School Diploma | GPA 97% Omaima Bint Al-Noaman High School, Isa Town, Bahrain | Graduated June 2021 

Core Skills

HR & Technical: HR Administration & Data Handling, Document Preparation, Intermediate MS Excel, Power BI (Dashboards & Analytics), MS Word, MS PowerPoint, Canva & Graphic Design Software. Professional & Interpersonal: Problem Solving, Leadership, Team & Task Management, Organization & Attention to Detail, Analytical & Research Skills, Communication, Adaptability, Time Management & Reliability. Languages: Arabic (Native), English (Fluent). 

Professional Experience

HR & PMS Intern | Gulf Air Group Headquarters, Muharraq, Bahrain October 2025 – December 2025

Managed HR administrative operations, including sorting and digitalizing employee files, drafting contracts and letters, and supporting assessments. Coordinated interview processes and maintained clear communication with trainees and applicants. Cleaned and analyzed HR data, resolved formula errors, and built performance calculation sheets to optimize workflow. Developed Power BI dashboards and executive PowerPoint presentations to translate raw HR metrics into actionable insights. Designed internal HR communications and promotional materials, including appreciation certificates and initiative materials (e.g., International Women’s Day).

Applied PMI tools and methodologies to direct a simulated project lifecycle in a remote team setting. Co-developed a creative proposal addressing a governmental issue, which was selected for further organizational review. Enhanced virtual collaboration, leadership, and cross-functional task management. 

Leadership & Volunteer Activities

Participant, Fintech Saudi Summer Camp | August 2025 – September 2025 Explored emerging financial technologies (AI, Blockchain, Entrepreneurship) and collaborated on real-world fintech case studies. Participant, Toastmasters Debating Skills Workshop | August 2025 Mastered Lincoln-Douglas debate formats, Toulmin’s Argument Model, and logical fallacy identification under expert mentorship. Major Representative, Bahrain Polytechnic Open Day | February 2025 Designed interactive activities and advised incoming high school graduates on the HRM degree program. Event Planner, Tamkeen A9eel Program | December 2018 – February 2019 Contributed to the positive work culture initiative by co-organizing career guidance events for prospective students. 

Personal Interests Reading, Drawing, and Visual Arts.

My ambition is defined by a unique perspective that blends an engineer's analytical mind with a dreamer's passion. turn promises into global reality, I aim to transition from an admirer on the ground to a contributor behind the scenes. I am seeking an entry-level role where I can channel my solid theoretical foundation, relevant certifications, and deep enthusiasm to support industry leaders in maintaining excellence and innovation. I am eager to learn from the very machines and organizations that fuel my aspirations, actively contributing to the future of flight

I am writing to express my interest in career opportunities within your organization. I
have recently graduated from the University of Bahrain with a Bachelor’s degree in
Banking & Finance and a minor in Data Analytics. My academic background, combined
with my internship and research experiences, has equipped me with both financial
expertise and strong analytical skills.
During my internship at the Bahrain Bourse – Trading Operations Department, I gained
practical experience in monitoring trading activities, preparing daily and weekly reports,
and developing dashboards using Power BI and Excel to support decision-making. This
hands-on exposure deepened my understanding of financial markets and strengthened
my ability to work with data-driven insights.
In addition, my graduation project focused on the adoption of Bahraini fintech
platforms (Bede and Floos), analyzing benefits, risks, and user trust. This research
allowed me to connect academic theories with real-world financial technology
applications, particularly in areas such as BNPL, micro-loans, and digital payments.
I am eager to bring my knowledge in finance, data analytics, and fintech innovation to
contribute to your team’s growth and success. I believe my background and skills make
me a strong candidate to add value to your organization.

أنا طالب دكتوراه في تحليل الأعمال، ولذلك شدّني أن الكتاب لا يطرح فكرته كشعار سياسي أو رأي شخصي فقط، بل يحاول اختبارها ودعمها بالبيانات والنماذج، ويتيح للقارئ مراجعة الأدلة وانتقادها. لا أعرف مسبقاً إن كنت سأتفق مع جميع استنتاجات الكتاب، لكنني مهتم بقراءة طرح جاد ومخالف للسائد، ثم تكوين رأيي الخاص فيه والكتابة عنه بصراحة وموضوعية
متشوق لي قراءة

أنا باحثٌ صاعد مهتم بالمرويات التاريخية والسياسية، وبالبحرين على وجه الخصوص، ولا سيما دراسة الأقليات غير المسلمة فيها. وقد لفت انتباهي عنوان الكتاب المميز، مما زاد من حماسي لقراءته والاستفادة من فكر الكاتب ومنهجه، وما استند إليه من نماذج مختلفة منشورة فيه . 
دائمًا ما أحرص، عند قراءة أي كتاب، على أن يرافقني قلم في رحلتي معه؛ لأدوّن ملاحظاتي وأملأ الهوامش والأوراق البيضاء بتأملاتي ونقدي عند أي نموذج أصل إليه، ومحاورًا آراء الكاتب، ومتوقفًا عند بعض القضايا التي يطرحها.

تحياتي لك دكتور، وأشكرك على هذه المبادرة الجميلة.
